en.lean_meat: The fresh-kill has gone scrawny and thin. All cats will need to eat more prey to survive.
en.forsaken: The stars have turned away. Leaders will only be given one life.
en.for_the_throne: Ambition rules. Deputies are more likely to murder the leader.
en.resolute: The deputy stands firm in their goals: duration before warrior focus can change is doubled.
en.fated_paths: Pawsteps are placed according to Silverpelt's design. Mates and ranks cannot be changed manually.
en.public_enemy: The other Clans do not welcome new neighbors. All Clans will start as hostile.
